title: Kenyan Chicken Stew
description: A flavorful and hearty stew from Kenya, made with tender chicken and vibrant spices.
instructions: Heat oil in a large pot over medium heat.
Add onion and garlic; cook until softened, about 5 minutes.
Add chicken; cook until browned, about 5-6 minutes.
Add carrots, potatoes, and Kenyan stew spice mix; cook for 1 minute.
Add tomato paste; cook for 1 minute.
Add chicken broth; bring to a boil.
Reduce heat to low; simmer, covered, until chicken is cooked through and vegetables are tender, about 20-25 minutes.
Stir in vibrant red bell pepper; cook for 2-3 minutes.
Season with salt and pepper to taste.
Serve hot over rice or with naan bread.
